sources.supports: A stop order becomes a market order when triggered; a stop-limit order may remain unfilled when the market moves through its limit.
FINRA is a not-for-profit broker-dealer self-regulatory organization overseen by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Daily short-sale volume is off-exchange transaction volume, is not consolidated with exchange data and is not short-interest position data.
Short-sale volume can include dealer facilitation and does not establish that an end-of-day short position was accumulated.
